_comment: A cooldown that applies a fire burn to every hostile in a 1.5-unit radius plus 0.05 per level: 6.3 HP plus 0.8 per level, in 3 ticks spaced 30 ticks (1 s) apart. Damage over time never crits, so this is priced a little higher than an equivalent direct hit to compensate. All values placeholder.
name: Ignite
